findings.title: Full-clause lexical governor overrides introduce cross-act contamination
findings.observed: G01 quotes the word if in a notice, then makes an explicit payment proposal; V10 emits conditional role/polarity. G03 supplies a complete date directive followed by an admin question; final '?' makes the date question-like, unlike the semicolon control G04. G05 takes a quoted do-not-pay action as the governor of a later choice of Friday. G06's unsupported choose predicate remains uncertain, which is preferable to borrowing quoted negation.
findings.mathematical_failure: Source-bound span proves where a token came from, not that its predicate/modal/negation governs this candidate. Current feature output has an incorrect derived role/polarity even though canonical re-parsing verifies it. DATE completion is closed in each control and must not be coupled mechanically to polarity or action eligibility.
findings.smallest_fix: Scan quotation intervals once; match governor candidates outside quoted mentions, in the candidate's local predicate/coordination region. Conditionals and question scope require a source-owned relation to that predicate. A separate coordinated/admin act cannot override it merely through punctuation or an earlier IF. If a relation or predicate is unsupported, retain unknown role/polarity rather than reuse a previous action. Keep raw lexical features available as source observations, derived governor fields explicitly weak/unqualified.

pass_conditions.required: Same payment-candidate role/polarity hypothesis; quoted IF cannot impose conditionality. Syntax complete and target [0] retained.
Same financial-candidate role/polarity and target. Preserve the independent admin-question act; no question-induced whole-turn blanking.
Quoted negative instruction cannot govern the subsequent date. Both may remain uncertain until CHOOSE is supported; do not require automatic asserted output.

findings.generalization_limit: No new authority-leak claim. These are exact designer-authored source counterexamples, not fresh gold or hosted frequency.

findings.title: Canonical re-parsing does not validate phase/role values as feature domains
findings.observed: A dict phase and list question.role pass canonical source parsing and become strings in features. Strict literal-True flags and forged-node rejection work in the confirmation probes.
findings.smallest_fix: Require phase/role to be scalar source-schema enum values or explicit unknown. Derive allowed domains from the versioned compiler/adapter schema; do not hardcode arbitrary brief policy values. Reject structured payloads or emit unknown with a typed diagnostic and affected-context mask. Apply the same validator to parse and feature extraction before constructing nodes. Metadata target labels/IDs remain outside privileged feature slots; raw utterance words are separate source features.
findings.privacy_limit: C01 uses only an invented nonprivate canary. This shows an unconstrained feature channel, not observed secret extraction. Numeric masking and lexical secret-word filters do not establish general privacy isolation. Parent-owned source/profile/privacy eligibility and current ingress remain separate.

families.construction: Connected components of the top-candidate interval-overlap graph, using strict positive overlap of raw extents.
families.sound_usage: Shared evidence for correlated hypothesis accounting; not proof of equal meaning or independence. Adjacent/disjoint candidates can still depend on the same governor, correction edge, readback or canonical source root.
families.parent_usage: AST children inherit parent target/role hypotheses and are operand evidence, not independent acts. Retain required child holes and explicit source-owner relations. Do not train/commit child facts as independent positive samples.
families.fold_usage: Canonical ancestry/source-root unions, not interval families, determine train/calibration/qualification separation. Ordered correction edges remain directed; only independent acts admit permutation invariance.
families.no_required_new_code: The family container is acceptable as a conservative non-equivalence representation while every authority/training mask remains false. No broader graph architecture is justified.

canonical_binding.guarantee: Checks consistency with this exact parser and supplied source/context; known node mutations fail.
canonical_binding.not_guaranteed: Authenticity/currentness of the supplied source event, current bank identity, component version or privacy. Caller-supplied event ID can be consistently re-parsed without independent ingress evidence.
canonical_binding.deployment: Keep offline/shadow until the original runtime can supply independently verified current ingress and component dependency bindings. Fixed AGENT_LLM / banktool-only deployment adds no inference API or bank tools.

bounded_cpu.optional_optimization: Only if actual CPU latency measurement warrants it, expose an internal parse-and-features bundle that parses once and never accepts detached external nodes. A cache key must include exact source bytes, context/schema/parser/feature version and event binding; no stale/source mixing.
bounded_cpu.cap: Future complete deployed inference bundle <=500000 bytes, including code/vocabulary/weights/decoder. Current 39670-byte coefficient-free package does not demonstrate a trained bundle footprint.

step_order.details: Resolve actual ancestry edges (including unresolved old links), profile/schema source compatibility and independent annotation closure. Union aliases, shared original source/template skeletons, contrast variants and masked rows before head-specific eligibility. Record evidence/reason for each edge and each unresolved edge; do not manufacture independent roots or borrow reviewed DEV.

Generate source candidates/features from frozen exact ingress fixture without annotation spans or labels; only then join independent reviewed TRAIN annotations for diagnostic admission. Store masks separately for primary, maximal DATE completion, relevance/maximality, target, privacy, reference/value resolution and source ancestry. Missing candidate or label is masked, never a negative. Report eligible canonical groups per class after each mask.

Include independent question/quoted governor clauses. Fully label all relevant candidate hypotheses, including unmatched lexical candidates, on TRAIN; retain reviewer disagreement and unresolved contexts. Contrast variants remain one root. Multiple authors/reviewers improve source diversity but do not establish human/IID gold.

control_algorithms.primary: Shuffle binary root labels among fully eligible canonical roots with the same required label/mask profile using one precommitted seed; every variant of a root keeps the assigned control label. Preserve actual class counts. Temporary control labels never replace saved annotations.
control_algorithms.paired_DATE: When every paired root has both classes, permuting identical label vectors is a no-op. Use a precommitted random whole-root label complement for the paired control, retaining both class labels and all root variants together; report the actual changed-label proportion and seed. Do not claim a control if labels stayed unchanged.
control_algorithms.governor_ablation: Remove source_role, source_polarity and governor_visibility derived slots together while preserving identical raw text/context inputs, masks, roots and folds. Compare against the explicit finite rule baseline to distinguish learned improvement from replay of grammar outputs.
control_algorithms.source_context_ablation: Report phase-only, raw-text-only and raw-text+phase/question context separately; scoped derived features are the final incremental comparison, not conflated with the mere presence of text.
control_algorithms.experimental_status: Algorithms specified only; no control labels generated, fits performed or annotations rewritten.

model_benefit_criterion.evidence: Use identical eligible roots/folds and preprocessing across controls; report per-group OOF masked BCE, errors, candidate/mask coverage and abstention for each head. For DATE compare both oracle-span diagnostics and actual candidate-pipeline outputs, clearly separate. Do not select on newly revealed blind qualification.
model_benefit_criterion.causal_diagnosis: An apparent gain from full-context over phase-only/text-only needs a source/role ablation and group-preserving permutation contrast; rule-derived feature gains may merely reproduce the finite governor rule. Keep learned scores and compiler authority separate.
model_benefit_criterion.uncertainties: Root-level paired differences and their actual distribution; any confidence bound must state sampling/exchangeability assumptions. Small authored/machine-reviewed data cannot establish general deployment risk.

risk_math.accepted_unit: Canonical source group; bad(g)=any erroneous accepted authority-relevant proposal in that group. Dependence within a root is not additional n. Preserve the selected sampling strata and report per-stratum coverage.
risk_math.one_sided_exact_zero_error: Under defensible IID accepted-group Bernoulli sampling within fixed predeclared strata and a frozen selector, upper95=1-0.05^(1/n); n=0 yields no usable risk bound. Dependence or heterogeneous/adaptive sampling requires a separately justified bound.
risk_math.qualifications: No current n/errors for qualified acceptance exist. The 20 engineering floor does not certify 95% low risk. Calibration fit vs risk vs blind qualification must remain separate; adaptive sweeps need fixed preselection or multiplicity accounted for.
